title: PROACT-Agent: Progressive Runtime Oversight and Active Circuit-breaking for Real-Time Safety
abstract: arXiv:2609.34415v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The transition from Large Language Models (LLMs) to agents shifts safety stakes from toxic text to irreversible environmental harm. While current defenses remain largely retrospective, proactive runtime intervention is bottlenecked by the lack of large-scale, causally-consistent data. We propose PROACT-Agent, a framework for synthesizing high-fidelity trajectories to enable real-time guardrails. We identify a critical "safety drift" in prior benchmarks, where lenient annotation paradigms fail to enforce temporal consistency. PROACT-Agent addresses this through: (1) Progressive Trajectory Unrolling to reveal risks hidden in long-context interactions; (2) Reasoning-Augmented Causal Rectification to enforce monotonic causal consistency; and (3) Culturally-Aware Data Localization for cross-border robustness. translated_title: PROACT-Agent：面向实时安全的渐进式运行时监督与主动熔断机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.34415v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：从大语言模型（LLM）向智能体的转变，将安全风险从有害文本升级为不可逆的环境危害。当前的防御手段大多仍停留在事后回顾层面，而主动的运行时干预则受制于缺乏大规模、因果一致的数据。我们提出PROACT-Agent，一个用于合成高保真轨迹以实现实时安全防护的框架。我们在既有基准中发现了一个关键的“安全漂移”问题，即宽松的标注范式未能保证时间上的一致性。PROACT-Agent通过以下方式解决该问题：（1）渐进式轨迹展开，揭示隐藏在长上下文交互中的风险；（2）推理增强的因果矫正，强制实现单调的因果一致性；（3）文化感知的数据本地化，增强跨境场景下的鲁棒性。我们进一步提出PROACT-Bench，一个包含通过多模型裁决标注的155,780个状态的双语安全基准。对……的评估
tldr: 提出PROACT-Agent框架，通过渐进式轨迹展开、推理增强的因果矫正和文化感知的数据本地化合成高保真安全轨迹数据，并构建包含15万余条标注状态的双语安全基准PROACT-Bench，以实现对大模型智能体的实时主动安全防护。
en_tdlr: PROACT-Agent enables real-time proactive safety guardrails for LLM agents by synthesizing high-fidelity trajectories through progressive trajectory unrolling, reasoning-augmented causal rectification, and culturally-aware data localization, accompanied by the bilingual PROACT-Bench benchmark with over 155,000 adjudicated safety states.
